# Commit Guide (from tourism project)

Based on conventional commits (@commitlint/config-conventional).

## Format
```
<type>[optional scope]: <description>

[optional body]

[optional footer(s)]
```

## Types
feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert

## Rules
- header-max-length: 150
- body-max-line-length: 200
- Use imperative, present tense
- Capitalize first letter? No, conventional uses lowercase type, lowercase first word after colon? Actually conventional uses lowercase.
